provenance.paper_title: LUMA-RAG: Lifelong Multimodal Agents with Provably Stable Streaming Alignment

evidence.section: Full paper: C. Multi-Tier Memory and Policy
evidence.paraphrase: Hot HNSW memory tier; compressed IVFPQ memory tier; CLAP-to-CLIP alignment bridge. cross-modal retrieval over aligned embedding spaces, including text-to-image and audio-to-image.
During operation, LUMA-RAG applies a fixed operational optimization objective to multimodal embeddings; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

evidence.section: Full paper: C. Multi-Tier Memory and Policy
evidence.paraphrase: Incremental orthogonal Procrustes updates maintain CLAP-to-CLIP alignment as streams evolve. For LUMA-RAG, this specifically supports migration between memory tiers of multimodal embeddings.
During operation, LUMA-RAG applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to multimodal embeddings; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (multimodal embeddings) changes through a fixed operational optimization objective, migration between memory tiers, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
